description: Public skills installed into ~/.agents/skills with the skills CLI. Jonas-authored skills live in pi/skills. Internal/private skills stay out of dotfiles and are managed by ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json or private checkouts.

grill-me.install: npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill grill-me -g --agent cline -y

skill-creator.install: npx skills add anthropics/skills --skill skill-creator -g --agent cline -y

vercel-react-best-practices.install: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill vercel-react-best-practices -g --agent cline -y

web-design-guidelines.install: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines -g --agent cline -y

next-cache-components.install: npx skills add vercel-labs/next-skills --skill next-cache-components -g --agent cline -y

vercel-sandbox.install: npx skills add vercel/vercel-plugin --skill vercel-sandbox -g --agent cline -y
vercel-sandbox.note: Local copy may differ from current public upstream. Review before updating.
